{{RV|type=command

|game1= argo
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Argo

|descr= Generate a JSON string from the provided array values.

|s1= [[gameValueToJson]] data

|p1= data: [[Array]] of [[Array]]s format [<nowiki/>[key, value], [key, value], ...]

|r1= [[String]] - a JSON string or an empty string if ''data'' is not an array

|x1= <sqf>_json = gameValueToJson [["ID", 42], ["Message", "Hello there!"], ["HasHighGround", true]];</sqf>
result:
<syntaxhighlight lang="json">
{
	"ID": 42,
	"Message": "Hello there!",
	"HasHighGround": true
}
</syntaxhighlight>
